limitations: Only already-valid owned input qualified; valid-input repair is not a malformed-CAD repair qualification.
Provider lineage targets prepared BRep before STEP export; original-face lineage through STEP reimport is unqualified.
Protected-face and cooperative-deadline refusals retained; no measured Hausdorff deviation.
Defeaturing explicitly changes material; it is not a silent meshing default or a public production repair API.

independent_file_inspections.scope: Existing completed all-element archive orientation/incidence/tag and numerical quality/achieved-size checks; Native CAD admission inherited. This update did not run those checks or render figures.

metric_conventions.native_quality_percentiles: Native reported percentiles linearly interpolate adjacent sorted values at fraction*(count-1).
metric_conventions.file_inspection_percentiles: File-inspection p01 and p95 use sorted values at floor(fraction*(count-1)); median is the conventional median.
metric_conventions.binding_scope: native_quality_binding checks minimum mean ratio, not equality of every percentile. Both conventions are retained without silently replacing either report.

reproduction.hash_scope: Only small JSON/code/log data was read and hashed; geometry/archive hashes are inherited from saved worker/inspection receipts.
reproduction.ledger_exclusions: Generation ledgers exclude compilation, fixture generation, loader setup, preparation checks, unit/API tests, rendering and independent file inspections.
reproduction.unknowns: Unavailable values stay null; no failed costs or earlier poorer candidate cohorts are discarded.
